rows.quote: JULY 9, 1973 - Mrs. JENNIE E. DARCH Mrs. Darch was a graduate of Thayer Academy, Class of 1902. Prior to coming to Lunenburg, she taught in Windsor, Mass., Westminster, and Fitchburg. In September, 1921, Mrs. Darch was appointed to teach Grades 4, 5, and 6 at the old West School on Whalom Road. She taught in this school until her retirement in June, 1954, after completing 33 years of service to the Town. -96-
